items.c: 瑶池阿母绮窗开，黄竹歌声动地哀。  八骏日行三万里，穆王何事不重来。

items.en: The Queen Mother of the West opens the patterned window at Yaochi; the Song of Yellow Bamboo moves the earth with grief. The eight steeds travel thirty thousand li a day; why does King Mu not return?

items.t: 雲母屏風燭影深，長河漸落曉星沉。  嫦娥應悔偷靈藥，碧海青天夜夜心。
items.c: 云母屏风烛影深，长河渐落晓星沉。  嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心。

items.en: Candle shadows deepen behind the mica screen; the Milky Way fades as the morning star sinks. Chang'e must regret stealing the elixir; facing the blue sea and sky, her heart aches night after night.

items.t: 宣室求賢訪逐臣，賈生才調更無倫。  可憐夜半虛前席，不問蒼生問鬼神。
items.c: 宣室求贤访逐臣，贾生才调更无伦。  可怜夜半虚前席，不问苍生问鬼神。

items.en: Seeking sages in the Xuan Room, the exiled official was visited; Jia Yi's talent was unmatched. Alas, at midnight the Emperor moved his seat forward, not to ask about the people, but about ghosts and spirits.

items.t: 冰簟銀床夢不成，碧天如水夜雲輕。  雁聲遠過瀟湘去，十二樓中月自明。
items.c: 冰簟银床梦不成，碧天如水夜云轻。  雁声远过潇湘去，十二楼中月自明。

items.en: On the icy mat and silver bed, dreams do not come; the blue sky is like water, night clouds are light. The sound of wild geese fades away towards Xiaoxiang; the moon shines brightly on the Twelve Towers.

items.t: 玄宗回馬楊妃死，雲雨難忘日月新。  終是聖明天子事，景陽宮井又何人。
items.c: 玄宗回马杨妃死，云雨难忘日月新。  终是圣明天子事，景阳宫井又何人。

items.en: Emperor Xuanzong turned his horse, and Consort Yang died; their love is unforgettable though time passes. Ultimately, it was the act of a wise emperor; otherwise, who would be in the well of Jingyang Palace?

items.t: 碧闌干外繡簾垂，猩色屏風畫折枝。  八尺龍鬚方錦褥，已涼天氣未寒時。
items.c: 碧阑干外绣帘垂，猩色屏风画折枝。  八尺龙须方锦褥，已凉天气未寒时。
items.p: bì lán gān wài xiù lián chuí ， xīng sè píng fēng huà zhé zhī 。   bā chǐ lóng xū fāng jǐn rù ， yǐ liáng tiān qì wèi hán shí 。

items.t: 江雨霏霏江草齊，六朝如夢鳥空啼。  無情最是台城柳，依舊煙籠十里堤。
items.c: 江雨霏霏江草齐，六朝如梦鸟空啼。  无情最是台城柳，依旧烟笼十里堤。

items.en: River rain falls heavily, river grass grows even; the Six Dynasties are like a dream, birds cry in vain. Most heartless are the willows of Taicheng, still shrouding the ten-mile dike in mist.

items.t: 誓掃匈奴不顧身，五千貂錦喪胡塵。  可憐無定河邊骨，猶是春閨夢裏人。
items.c: 誓扫匈奴不顾身，五千貂锦丧胡尘。  可怜无定河边骨，犹是春闺梦里人。
items.p: shì sǎo xiōng nú bù gù shēn ， wǔ qiān diāo jǐn sàng hú chén 。   kě lián wú dìng hé biān gǔ ， yóu shì chūn guī mèng lǐ rén 。

items.en: Swearing to sweep away the Xiongnu regardless of self; five thousand soldiers in sable brocade perished in the barbarian dust. Alas, the bones by the Wuding River are still the men in the dreams of maidens in their spring boudoirs.

items.t: 別夢依依到謝家，小廊回合曲闌斜。  多情只有春庭月，猶為離人照落花。
items.c: 別梦依依到谢家，小廊回合曲阑斜。  多情只有春庭月，犹为离人照落花。

items.en: Parting dreams linger and return to the Xie house; the small corridor winds, the curved railing slants. Only the moon in the spring courtyard is affectionate, still shining on the fallen flowers for the departed one.

items.t: 勸君莫惜金縷衣，勸君惜取少年時。  花開堪折直須折，莫待無花空折枝。
items.c: 劝君莫惜金缕衣，劝君惜取少年时。  花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝。

items.en: I urge you not to cherish the robe of golden thread, but to cherish the time of your youth. When flowers bloom and can be picked, you must pick them; do not wait until there are no flowers and break the empty branch.
